description: Products that sell this week in their market, and their sales per month. No resale price or profit: estimate none. Their cost on 1688: the quote, with the idea’s `reference_produit`. Call it as soon as they have no idea or ask what to sell. Optional: their words, a category, a budget per piece, a sort order.

mots.description: Optional: the product or item they are looking for, in plain words (“throw blanket”, “LED lamp”, “dog harness”); synonyms separated by a comma (“throw, blanket”). Never an adjective: “cheap”, “good margins”, “trending” go through tri or prix_max. Never a holiday or a season alone: for a holiday (Christmas, Halloween, Mother’s Day…), pick yourself the three items that sell best for THAT holiday — something you hold in your hand, never a category (“decor”, “gift”) —, separated by a comma, the first one first — that is the one the app searches if the list has none. Never the item of another holiday.

niche.description: Optional: the category they name — maison, cuisine, mode, bien-être, sport, tech et audio, téléphone, bijoux et montres, animaux, bébé, auto, outils et bureau, gadgets.

prix_max.description: Optional: their purchase budget per piece (“under 10” → 10).

tri.description: Facultatif : « ce qui part le plus », « de bonnes marges », « ce qui rapporte » → ventes ; « pas cher », « cheap », « à petit prix » → prix_bas.

name: ideas_of_the_week
title: Ideas of the week
